text:
tara: Heads up — CS flagged a few customers saying "billing shows other project" after SA fallback. can we triage?

mike: saw that. root cause seems to be router fallback -> pooled project. console still surfaces the original SA in the header so customers get confused.

nina: router currently writes X-Billed-Project into internal metrics only. we never surface X-Effective-Identity to the console or logs pipeline.

ben: we need to be careful with private installs — can't send tenant/project ids to telemetry upstream. default should be aggregated counts for private.

julia: UX ask: in the console show a compact label "Billing subject" next to token usage and a small "why?" tooltip. link should open a filtered log view for that org.

nina: proposal: low-overhead metric + sampled event. Metric: `auth.routing.fallback.count{org,reason}`. Sampled event (only for chosen orgs or traces): `auth.routing.decision` with a short payload. include routing_hash so we can tie metric->event.

nina: sample payload (example):
```
requested: sa:team-llm
effective: proj-pool-7
reason: capacity_fallback
routing_hash: a1b2c3d4
decision_ts: 2026-03-23T17:30:00Z
sampled: true
```

mike: +1. cardinality control: no full emails, use short ids; sample at org-level (e.g., 1% by default) and 100% for support + SRE.

ben: For private deployments add config `telemetry.emit_mode = [off|aggregated|full]`. default `aggregated`. when set to `full` customers explicitly opt-in and route events to their telemetry sink.

cs-bot: ticket #CS-3421 linked: "billing mismatch — org: acme". assigned to @mike.

julia: Console drill: card shows "Billed project" and "Acting service account" separately. clicking the billed project opens a prefilled query: `routing_hash = <value>` + time range.

mike: alerting idea: create a warning when fallback rate > 0.5% over 30m for an org, send to triage-notify (not full page). if spike persists 1h escalate to oncall.

nina: implementation plan:
- router: attach `routing_hash` + `effective_id` to request context (cheap).
- metrics: increment `auth.routing.fallback.count` with tags (org,reason).
- events: sampled sink for `auth.routing.decision` stored 30d.
- console: new labels + drilldown, feature flag `auth.routing.v1_telemetry`.

infra-bot: deploy queued for router change on canary-2. CI: green.

tara: can we get a short runbook blurb for CS so they can explain to customers? a 1-paragraph note would help.

julia: will draft tooltip copy and a 1-paragraph CS blurb: explains pooled billing, why it happens, how to request pinned capacity.

mike: I'll open PR for router header change + metric emission, tag @nina for telemetry.

nina: I'll follow with pipeline PR and sampling config. will also add private-deploy behavior.

tara: thanks team — please drop PR links here when ready so CS can reference. :thumbsup:
